review.description: S4/S5 require shared phony preparation inside each verification invocation, fresh standalone and independent preparation, ordered phases and stop on failure. Explicit MAKEFLAGS replacement preserves variable flavor and literal dollars; normal standalone keep-going behavior remains. Exact comparison/bootstrap, fixture-only execution, package provenance and uncached race testing remain required.
review.implementation: Reviewed real Make dependency edges and strict wrapper commands, ci.py exact-plan dispatch and direct verify.sh fixture override against current main. The target catalog gains exactly the original PR assertion/purpose delta while retaining every PR14 mapping; source-correspondence and catalog-merge-proof artifacts document unchanged executable bytes and preserved target additions. Reconciliation and make ci remain separate invocations.
review.tests: Read actual VerificationGraphTests recorder and assertions: all six entrypoints count each preparation once, reject stale/deleted output, serialize phases under -j8, fail every phase without later commands under keep-going, preserve exact FLOW_ARGS plus raw MAKEFLAGS caller flavor/dollars/TMPDIR, and execute no tools under -n. Hosted dispatch uses timeout=30 and asserts unchanged exact SHAs. Existing CI tests retain restricted root bootstrap and artifact identity checks; fixture overrides and Go -race -count=1 are asserted separately. Fresh focused tests, full CLI reconciliation and separate local CI provide current execution evidence; historical review success is not reused.
